masking.measured: exact lambda_min of Ghat = G/(a L^2)

ccm_bridge.arch_quadrature: finite window R=400, 80 panels; truncation tail ~ log R / R

masking_observed.lambda_2.0: negative already at delta*L = 0.24; lambda_min = -0.0000 at delta = 0 (bulk singular, d > N)

key_results.oversampled_regime_finding: for lambda > 1 the probe grid oversamples (d/N = lambda > 1), the on-line Gram is PSD of rank <= N < d, and every delta > 0 produces a strictly negative eigenvalue in the synthetic model

ccm_channel_match.pole: h(i/2)+h(-i/2) = 2 * pole_component, agreement to 10 digits, all tested (n,m), both lambdas
ccm_channel_match.prime: sum_k Lambda(k) k^-1/2 (K(log k)+K(-log k)) = 2 * prime_component, agreement to 10 digits, all tested (n,m)
ccm_channel_match.archimedean_offdiagonal: ratio to arch_component = -1.90..-1.97, consistent with -2 within the R=400 truncation tail for |arch|~0.23
ccm_channel_match.archimedean_diagonal: ratio = -1.5907/-1.5852 at (0,0) and -0.7483/-1.0626 at (1,1); NOT consistent with -2 (truncation moves these by <=0.006)
ccm_channel_match.assembly: off-diagonal (1,0): 2M=0.14257 vs zero-sum(200)=0.12991, diff -0.0127 (right size/sign for the unaccounted positive zero tail); diagonals (0,0) and (1,1) off by a near-constant 1.064
ccm_channel_match.verdict: conjecture M = (1/2)*Weil-Gram is REFUTED as stated; the discrepancy is localized to the diagonal archimedean term, which is also the part left unconstrained by the R004 displacement identity

bounded_claim.statement: In a finite synthetic model of a probe window, the negative index of the zero-side Gram separates an injected off-line pair from on-line configurations, with visibility threshold delta*L ~ sqrt(6/lambda) and detection at every delta > 0 in the oversampled regime lambda > 1. Separately, the R004 CCM matrix matches the Weil literature form exactly (factor 2) on the pole and prime channels and on the off-diagonal archimedean channel, but NOT on the diagonal archimedean term: the identity conjecture is refuted as stated and the gap is localized to one channel.

nonclaims: No RH evidence, no RH route closure.
The masking diagnostic uses a synthetic on-line zero lattice, not the zeros of zeta.
No windowed-visibility theorem is claimed; only the block-level separation is proved (in Lean).
The arithmetic leg is RH-equivalent by Weil's criterion (OBS-009) and is not advanced here.
The off-diagonal archimedean agreement is 'consistent with' at the achieved quadrature accuracy, not an asserted match.
No CCM identity is claimed; the conjecture as stated is refuted.
open_obligations: Re-run the archimedean channel with a tail-corrected or contour-deformed quadrature to assert or refute the off-diagonal factor -2.
Determine whether a diagonal normalization exists making M exactly (1/2)*(Weil zero-side Gram) in this basis.
Decide the windowed-visibility question (R002_WINDOWED_VISIBILITY) or record it as a wall.
No FFBBP/OoL numerical certificate has mathematical theorem authority; Lean/comparator remains the promotion gate.
